lines.beaver: 안녕하세요, 민수 씨. 무슨 좋은 소식 있어요?
lines.beaver_roman: annyeonghaseyo, minsu ssi. museun joeun sosik isseoyo?
lines.learner: 네, 우리 동네에 새 공장이 생긴대요.
lines.en: Yes, they say a new factory is coming to our town.
lines.roman: ne, uri dongnee sae gongjangi saenggindaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Really? What kind of business is it?
lines.en: They say it's an iron-making business.

lines.beaver_en: An iron factory? It must be a big company.
lines.en: Yes, an oil company is joining too.

lines.beaver_en: Then won't it smell like oil?

lines.en: They say construction starts next spring.

lines.beaver_en: Sooner than I thought. Where did you hear that?
lines.en: City hall held a briefing about the factory.

lines.beaver_en: What else did they talk about there?
lines.en: They'll also build a power plant next to it.

lines.beaver_en: Electricity too? There will be lots of jobs.
lines.learner: 네, 그래서 사업에 대한 기대가 커요.
lines.en: Yes, so people expect a lot from the business.
lines.roman: ne, geuraeseo saeobe daehan gidaega keoyo.

lines.beaver: 그 회사에 대해 더 알아볼 수 있을까요?
lines.beaver_en: Could we find out more about that company?
lines.beaver_roman: geu hoesae daehae deo arabol su isseulkkayo?
lines.learner: 다음 주에 회사 설명 모임이 있대요.
lines.en: They say there's a company briefing next week.
lines.roman: daeum jue hoesa seolmyeong moimi itdaeyo.

lines.beaver_en: Great. Let's go and listen together.
lines.learner: 네, 그럼 다음 주에 같이 가요!
lines.en: Okay, let's go together next week!
lines.roman: ne, geureom daeum jue gachi gayo!
